categories.main_business_segments: Qinghai Salt Lake Industry Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the chemical manufacturing sector focusing on potassium and lithium products. Its main business segments include production and sales of potassium chloride (KCl), lithium carbonate, and related chemical products. The company also engages in trade, hotel management, retail, and logistics services as supplementary segments.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced salt lake resource extraction technologies, including adsorption and membrane separation for lithium extraction from brine with high magnesium-lithium ratios. It has mastered multiple potassium chloride processing technologies such as reverse flotation, cold crystallization, and vacuum crystallization. The firm continuously innovates in refining and optimizing production processes to improve resource utilization and product quality, supported by a robust R&D system with patented technologies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are agricultural sectors requiring potassium fertilizers and lithium product consumers in the new energy industry, including battery manufacturers for electric vehicles and energy storage. The company serves domestic markets predominantly but is expanding its presence internationally, especially in regions rich in potassium and lithium resources such as Africa and Southeast Asia.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Qinghai Province, China, particularly around the Qaidam Basin and Chaerhan Salt Lake. It also has subsidiaries and investments in other Chinese provinces and overseas locations including Mauritius and Congo for mining investments. The domestic market accounts for the vast majority of revenue, with minimal but growing international exposure.
categories.supply_chain_position: Qinghai Salt Lake Industry is positioned upstream and midstream in the supply chain, focusing on raw material extraction (potassium, lithium, magnesium) from salt lakes and processing these into chemical products. It controls mining rights and production facilities, supplying processed chemical products to downstream fertilizer manufacturers and battery producers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes building a world-class salt lake industrial base with a focus on green, efficient, and sustainable resource development. R&D efforts target breakthroughs in salt lake resource comprehensive utilization, high-value magnesium products, lithium deep processing, and extraction of rare elements like rubidium and cesium. It emphasizes technological innovation, industrial chain extension, and integration with national strategies such as carbon neutrality and new energy development.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of chemical products including potassium chloride fertilizers and lithium carbonate. The company also earns income from trade activities, hotel and retail operations, and investment returns. Sales are mostly on a product basis with some service and processing contracts, supported by government subsidies and strategic partnerships.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic producer of potassium and lithium products, holding about 35% of the domestic potassium chloride market and approximately 8% of the national lithium carbonate production capacity. It competes with other large resource-based fertilizer producers such as Zangge Mining and Guotou Luokai. Its strategic integration with China Minmetals and China Salt Lake Industrial Group enhances its competitive positioning and global influence.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 15.13 billion, a decline of nearly 30% from the previous year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 4.66 billion, down 41%. Total assets stood at RMB 45.78 billion with net assets of RMB 36.57 billion, showing steady scale and solid financial health. The company is investing heavily in expanding lithium production capacity and optimizing potassium fertilizer output, aiming for growth through technological and market expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Qinghai Salt Lake Industry leverages its unique access to rich salt lake mineral resources and advanced extraction technologies to offer high-quality potassium and lithium products with superior purity and efficiency. Its integrated industrial chain and patented technologies enable cost-effective production and resource sustainability. The company positions itself as a key supplier ensuring national food security through potassium fertilizers and supporting the new energy sector with lithium products, emphasizing green production and innovation-driven growth.
